transcript: From KGW News, this is Straight Talk with Laurel Porter. Hello, and welcome to Straight Talk. I'm Laurel Porter. Here to tell us more, I'm pleased to welcome our final straight talk guest of 2020, Oregon Senator Jeff Merkley. Welcome back, Senator. It's nice to have you here and happy holidays.
